rubrics.name: Findable
rubrics.rationale: no PID detected and publisher not a recognized sustainable repository

rubrics.name: Interoperable
rubrics.rationale: metadata is JSON-LD but references no standard vocabulary; 3 machine-readable schema entities

rubrics.name: Reusable
rubrics.rationale: machine-readable license linked in the metadata (MIT); no AI/ML prohibition language found in license or use terms

rubrics.name: Transparent
rubrics.rationale: source described in prose only (rai:dataCollection); score 0 if the text does not actually name a source

rubrics.name: Traceable
rubrics.rationale: no transformation steps (Computation or Experiment entities) in the crate

rubrics.name: Interpretable
rubrics.rationale: no software entities in the crate

rubrics.name: Key actors identified
rubrics.rationale: 0 of 1 authors carry a PID; 1 named in free text only

rubrics.name: Semantics
rubrics.rationale: abstract and keywords present, no controlled-vocabulary terms

rubrics.name: Standards
rubrics.rationale: 3 schema entities but no standard-vocabulary binding found

rubrics.name: Potential Sources of Bias
rubrics.rationale: no bias, missingness, limitations, or completeness description anywhere in the metadata

rubrics.name: Data documentation template
rubrics.rationale: no human-readable datasheet; 3 of 9 machine-readable sections populated

rubrics.name: Fit for purpose
rubrics.rationale: use cases stated only partially (appropriate or inappropriate, not both)

rubrics.name: Verifiable
rubrics.rationale: no checksums found

rubrics.name: Ethically managed
rubrics.rationale: no sensitivity classification, sensitivity statement, or management description

rubrics.name: Secure
rubrics.rationale: no security-level metadata

rubrics.name: Persistent
rubrics.rationale: no PID on the deposit; 18 datasets have a contentUrl but no recognized archive detected

rubrics.name: Domain-appropriate
rubrics.rationale: no recognized repository host detected

rubrics.name: Well-governed
rubrics.rationale: no DMP / governance plan in the metadata

rubrics.name: Standardized
rubrics.rationale: formal schema/standard declared, so structural validation is possible; no populated standard-vocabulary bindings — semantic conformance cannot be deterministically validated (the 1-rule)

rubrics.name: Contextualized
rubrics.rationale: some context present but incomplete (example data or withheld-information description missing)

note: Only criteria with an automated estimate are counted; the rest need human or model judgment and are listed in unestimated_criteria.
